articles.title: rugguard-pydantic-ai-agent added to PyPI
articles.summary: A new Pydantic AI integration kit for RugGuard is available, designed to enhance AI trading agents. It allows for quick addition of a 'pretrade_check' tool using minimal code. This tool delivers Pydantic models containing prescriptive policy recommendations on every call, aiming to streamline and improve decision-making in automated trading systems. This development could boost efficiency in financial technology.

articles.title: New Lanterns Footage Reveals Best Look at Hal Jordan’s Green Lantern Powers

articles.title: Wolves starlet bags unfortunate double-whammy against Fulham
articles.summary: Championship-bound Wolves, currently at the bottom of the 2025-26 Premier League season, have little left to play for beyond pride in their final games. Despite facing imminent relegation, the article hints at a potentially brighter future ahead for the Molineux club, offering a glimpse of hope for fans beyond their immediate disappointment.

articles.title: 4 alien species pulled from crashed UFOs, ex-government researcher claims
articles.summary: A former CIA-funded government researcher, Dr. Hal Puthoff, sensationally claimed that the US has recovered four distinct species of extraterrestrial life from crashed UFOs. This unverified assertion, reportedly from an individual associated with a former Pentagon program, reignites public debate on UFO phenomena and potential government involvement in retrieving advanced non-human technology, though official confirmation is absent.

articles.title: How To Watch Markiplier's Iron Lung At Home
articles.summary: YouTuber Markiplier (Mark Fischbach) announced at the Cannes Film Festival details for his feature-length directorial debut, "Iron Lung." The horror film, based on his popular video game adaptation, is anticipated by fans and marks a significant transition for the online content creator into mainstream filmmaking. This news highlights the evolving landscape of entertainment and content creation.

articles.title: Ukraine drones kill four in Russia, Moscow faces biggest attack in over a year
articles.summary: Ukraine launched its largest drone attack on Moscow in over a year, causing at least four fatalities, including three in the the Moscow region. This significant overnight operation underscores the escalating nature of the ongoing conflict, bringing direct consequences to the Russian capital. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the complexities and reach of modern warfare tactics.

articles.title: Ukrainian drone strikes on Russia kill 4, wound 12 others, while debris lands on Moscow airport
articles.summary: Ukraine launched one of its most extensive drone strikes on Russia, resulting in at least four deaths, including three near Moscow, and a dozen injuries. Local authorities reported widespread debris impacts. This significant escalation underscores the evolving nature of the conflict, the increasing impact of drone warfare, and critical international security challenges for the region.
